title: A member card's link can be any page on Frequency, picked from a search, or any pasted link
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22: the one personal card should be assignable to anywhere on the site, or any link. Open my link now has a search box above the link field that finds any public page (Spaces, events, Journeys, practices, Circles, Channels, people, partners, offers and site features) with the same public-only search the CyberUnicorn console's page tags use (lib/devices/tag-targets.ts searchTagTargets), so nothing private, draft or removed is offered. Picking a result fills the link with the page's full address; anything else is still pasted. findCardPages is open to any signed-in member. Follows LIVE-1282 and ADR-1874; no migration.
